label: We Work Remotely
terms_note: Public RSS feeds per category; apply on the employer's page or by e-mail.

endpoints.call: the public RSS feeds (application/rss+xml: all jobs and per-category) are usable public feeds
endpoints.notes: from the docs / live response read on 2026-09-05

reference.limits: Not published on the pages opened. HTML pages sit behind a Cloudflare interstitial (403) for the audit host; the RSS endpoints answer normally. Terms page not readable (also via r.jina.ai) — no automation clause read; robots.txt 7 rules. No developer API.

search.note: We Work Remotely all-jobs RSS 2.0 feed (~80 current remote jobs, ~800 KB). query is not sent (the feed documents no search parameter) - filter the returned postings client-side; the feed answers its whole current list in one response, so ignore next_page (page 2 is the same list). title is '<company>: <job title>'; location is the WWR region ('Anywhere in the World'); country, skills, category, type and expires_at stay in raw. description is HTML. id is the job link.

not_offered.me: No credentials to verify ('auth: none'): the feed is public and has no account endpoint.
not_offered.get_posting: The feed has no per-item endpoint (each posting's url is an HTML page); search returns the whole record in raw.
not_offered.apply: No application endpoint: the feed only lists postings; candidates apply on each posting's url (employer page / e-mail).
not_offered.list_messages: No messaging API; the only machine-readable interface is the public job feed.

live_check.notes: fixed (runtime): the feed sends no page parameter but advertised next_page and repeated page 1; next_page is now null; all read tools answered, schema-valid
